user_text: Summarize the benefits of code review for a small team.
assistant_text:
**Benefits of Code Review for Small Teams:**

- **Catches bugs early** before they reach production
- **Shares knowledge** across team members
- **Maintains consistency** in coding style and standards
- **Improves code quality** through collaborative feedback
- **Reduces single points of failure** by spreading code familiarity
- **Encourages learning** and mentorship opportunities
Code review helps small teams catch bugs early, share knowledge, and maintain consistent, high-quality code.

1. **Bug detection** – Catches errors before they reach production, saving time and costs.
2. **Knowledge sharing** – Ensures all team members understand the codebase, reducing dependency on one person.
Code review fosters a **collaborative culture** where team members give and receive constructive feedback, building trust and shared ownership of the codebase.

user_text: State one risk if reviews are skipped.
assistant_text: Skipping code reviews risks **knowledge silos**, where only one person understands critical parts of the codebase, creating a dangerous single point of failure.
Track **defect escape rate** — the percentage of bugs found in production versus those caught during review — to measure the effectiveness of your code review process.
Consistent code reviews are a small investment that pays off in fewer bugs, stronger teams, and healthier codebases.

• Regular code reviews catch bugs early and reduce production issues.
• They build team knowledge, trust, and shared code ownership.
• Skipping them risks silos, defects, and fragile codebases.
Code reviews are essential for quality, collaboration, and long-term team success.
Code reviews can slow delivery if not timeboxed, so keep them focused and efficient.
Keep reviews short, focused, and regular for maximum team benefit.
Code reviews boost quality, share knowledge, and strengthen teams—keep them consistent and efficient.
